messages:
Sam F.: FYI invoice MDL-2026-042 from Maple Data Labs arrived asking for a gross-up for "US taxes" before payment. Invoice USD 9,200. Vendor says they won't provide W-8 unless we agree to gross-up. Thoughts?

Priya T.: Quick question: is Maple Data Labs a Canadian corporation or an individual contractor? That affects whether W-8BEN-E vs W-8BEN is needed.

Sam F.: They're a registered Canadian corp (incorp number on vendor record). Contact is asking for gross-up clause because they claim potential US withholding if paperwork missing.

CJ M.: We don't have a policy to gross-up vendor invoices for tax liabilities. Historically we require the correct tax form (W-8BEN-E for non-US entities) and then pay net. If they refuse, we escalate to legal but typically we hold payment until form is provided.

Evan L.: I replied to vendor asking for W-8BEN-E and reminded them Redwood is a US payer and needs W-8BEN-E to document foreign status. I also flagged we won't modify invoice amounts for gross-up without a contract amendment.

Sam F.: Placing payment on hold while we get the form. AP-bot, set hold and notify vendor email thread.

AP-bot: Payment hold placed on invoice MDL-2026-042 62; reason: missing W-8BEN-E and vendor requested gross-up. AP queue notified.

Priya T.: Tax note for the thread: For Canadian suppliers providing services performed outside the US, there is typically no US withholding required. The W-8BEN-E establishes non-US status; we should request Part I/II filled and an authorized signature. If they perform services inside the US, different rules may apply and we may need to review treaty positions.

CJ M.: Good point. Sam, ask vendor to confirm where the services were performed (country of execution). If they confirm Canada and provide W-8BEN-E, we'll release payment net. If they claim work performed in US and insist on gross-up, escalate to Legal + Tax for contract amendment request.

Evan L.: Drafted vendor message below. Sam, feel free to copy/send: 

"Hi Maple Data Labs team, thanks for invoice MDL-2026-042 (USD 9,200). To process payment we need your completed W-8BEN-E (signed and dated) to certify your foreign status. Please confirm the country where the services were performed. Per Redwood policy we do not gross-up invoices for potential tax liabilities absent a contractual agreement. If services were performed in the US, please indicate that so we can route to Tax and Legal for review. Payment will remain on hold until we receive the completed form and service-country confirmation. Please return documents within 5 business days to avoid further delay.

Best, Evan on behalf of Redwood AP"

Sam F.: Sent to vendor at 2026-05-02T18:04:12Z cc: vendor-ops.

AP-bot: Vendor message posted to maple-payments@example.com; hold expiry set to 2026-05-09 unless form received earlier.

Priya T.: I'll pre-check the vendor's Canadian registration and keep an eye for any treaty considerations if they claim US-sourced income.

CJ M.: OK. No gross-up unless Legal signs off on a contract amendment. Reopen thread when vendor responds or if we need to escalate.

Sam F.: Closing loop for now. Will update when W-8 arrives or if vendor pushes back. :white_check_mark:
